body: Focus now shows pinned cards, actionable attention and unread reports, date plans active today, then timed Events for today. Pins retain every status/archive state. Server queries use the workspace timezone and independent bounded pages. Full local gate and Focus/events/protocol/dialogs release browser checks pass; the current HTTPS app was rebuilt and restarted with existing source versions, pins and certificates preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-26-focus-daily-sections.md. Physical-device acceptance remains open.

metadata.summary: Focus separates pins, attention, daily plans and events
